$description: Tier 2: the semantic contract. This file declares WHICH semantic tokens exist, what type they are, and what they mean. It deliberately holds no values. Every theme in src/themes must supply a value for every entry here, or `bun run tokens:build` fails. That failure is the whole point: it makes theme drift impossible instead of merely discouraged.

sunken.$description: Recessed area on the canvas, e.g. a code block or well.

raised.$description: Card and panel background sitting above the canvas.

overlay.$description: Floating surface: modal, popover, tooltip, toast, select menu.

scrim.$description: Full-viewport wash behind a modal. Must be translucent.

control.$description: Default background for inputs and unfilled controls.

control-hover.$description: Input or control background on hover.

disabled.$description: Background for any disabled control. Never communicate disabled with opacity alone.

selected.$description: Background for a selected row, option, or tab.

accent-subtle.$description: Low-emphasis accent wash. Safe behind accent text.

accent-bold.$description: High-emphasis accent fill for primary actions.

neutral-subtle.$description: Low-emphasis neutral fill, e.g. secondary button rest.

success-subtle.$description: Success wash for badges and inline status.

primary.$description: Default body and heading text. Must clear 4.5:1 on surface.canvas and surface.raised.

secondary.$description: Supporting text. Must clear 4.5:1 on canvas.

subtle.$description: De-emphasized metadata and helper text. Must clear 4.5:1 on canvas.

placeholder.$description: Input placeholder. Must clear 4.5:1 on surface.control, since placeholders carry meaning.

disabled.$description: Disabled control label. Exempt from AA by WCAG 1.4.3, but kept at 3:1 as a house rule.

accent.$description: Accent-colored text on a neutral surface.

success.$description: Success text on a neutral or success-subtle surface.

subtle.$description: Hairline that defines structure without drawing attention. The system's default divider.

default.$description: Structural border on a non-interactive container. Decorative by contract: never use it as the boundary of a control, that is what border.control exists for.

strong.$description: Emphasized decorative border, e.g. a hovered card edge.

control.$description: Resting boundary of an interactive control: input, select, checkbox, radio, switch track, secondary button. Must clear 3:1 against surface.control, surface.canvas and surface.raised in every theme. Enforced by the build, see contrast.json.

control-hover.$description: Boundary of a hovered interactive control. Must clear 3:1 against surface.control-hover and must never be quieter than border.control.

accent.$description: Accent border for selected or active elements.

focus.$description: Focus ring color. Must clear 3:1 against every adjacent surface. Never overridden per-component.

raised.$description: Card resting above the canvas. Most cards should use a border instead.

modal.$description: Dialog. The highest elevation in the system.

none.$description: Explicit no-shadow, so components can opt out without hardcoding `none`.

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, checkboxes, badges. Theme-owned, so a future theme can change control geometry without touching a component.

pill.$description: Fully rounded, for pill badges and switches.

mono.$description: Token values, code, and numeric tables.
